$comment: Real reference-manager exports for src/lib/reference-manager-corpus.test.js. See README.md for the fields and how to add a file.

files.quirks: A date with zero month and day, as NASA ADS supplies it
Chinese and Japanese titles, authors, and places
EDTF dates: ranges, circa, seasons, open ends
The same EDTF dates as CSL-JSON, including BC years written as strings
files.knownGaps: Item 14 is skipped: its BC years are strings ("-334"), and the CSL sanitizer only accepts a negative year as a number.

files.quirks: Creators from the Extra field, uppercase DOI
Bare month macro, double-braced title, no author
Multi-letter initials and a numeric year
Name particles (van, de, d', 't) in every position; 54 entries, so the paste cap of 50 applies
files.knownGaps: The last 4 of 54 entries stay in the paste box (MAX_ENTRIES_PER_PASTE is 50).

files.quirks: Web pages exported as @misc with howpublished and note
@Preamble and @String blocks, prose comments between entries, DOIs written as URLs, LaTeX accents, jabref-meta @Comment footer

files.source: Contributed by Dan Knauss, 2026-10-27: Zotero 10.0.6 on macOS, a fresh library holding borges-sample.ris (12 published works), exported through Zotero's local API (/api/users/0/items/top?format=…), which runs the built-in export translators with default options
files.quirks: Leading blank line, tab indentation, {Protected} capitals in titles, bare month = sep, raw UTF-8, particles inline (van der Walt, de Beauvoir), @mastersthesis, @techreport, @misc web page with urldate, a corporate author in double braces. The access date reads 2024-03-12 for a sample that says 2024/03/11: Zotero stored the local date (UTC-6) in UTC
files.knownGaps: The @misc web page imports as type document, not webpage, and the conference paper has no booktitle (Zotero writes none).

files.quirks: journaltitle, date, langid (english, german, french), location with {MA}/{DC} protection, @thesis with type, @report, @online, eventtitle, editorb with editorbtype = redactor. The access date reads 2024-03-12 for a sample that says 2024/03/11: Zotero stored the local date (UTC-6) in UTC
files.knownGaps: The Stanford Encyclopedia editor (editorb, editorbtype = redactor) is dropped.

The access date reads 2024-03-12 for a sample that says 2024/03/11: Zotero stored the local date (UTC-6) in UTC

files.source: Contributed by Dan Knauss, 2026-10-27: Zotero 10.0.6 on macOS, a fresh library holding borges-sample.ris (12 published works), exported through Zotero's local API (/api/users/0/items/top?format=…), which runs the built-in export translators with default options
files.quirks: CRLF line endings (kept by .gitattributes), DA dates like 1962///, CONF for the conference paper, A2 for a series editor
files.knownGaps: Borges does not import RIS. Online, the 4 records with a DO line are looked up on CrossRef by DOI alone (so the RIS fields are ignored) and the other 8 come back as unreadable input; the test runs offline, so all 12 are errors. Kept as a sample for deciding whether to import RIS.
